title: Reading Buddies
description: Fill a watercolor picture book by matching pictures and words, listening closely, and building friendly three-letter words.
learningGoals: Connect spoken words, familiar pictures, and printed CVC words
Listen for a whole word and identify its pictured meaning
Sequence three letter sounds to build a short word
interactionModel: custom DOM storybook with three-word sessions across picture-word tap/drag matching, spoken-word picture choice, and ordered letter building
feedbackModel: Gentle spoken retries preserve progress; idle help repeats and then highlights; every word earns a full-page Great Match reveal and every session fills a stamped picture book.
credits: Kaigani; watercolor storybook production art developed with GPT Image 2-class generation and approved Qwen/Krea local workflows; teacher narration created with Qwen voice clone and Whisper QA. Built with Codex for QLOBE Kids.
